name: Los Cerritos Center
description: Los Cerritos Center is a major regional shopping mall serving the Southeast Los Angeles County area, featuring over 130 retailers and dining options anchored by Macy's and other major department stores. The center offers a diverse mix of national chains, specialty stores, and services in a climate-controlled indoor environment. Located at the intersection of the 605 and 91 freeways, it provides convenient access for shoppers throughout the region.
demographics: Los Cerritos Center attracts a diverse, predominantly middle-class customer base reflecting the Southeast LA County demographic mix, with strong representation from Asian American and Hispanic families. The trade area consists primarily of households with median to upper-middle incomes ranging from $60,000-$100,000, with a significant proportion of married couples with children seeking value-oriented shopping options. Visitors tend to be multi-generational family groups who engage in comparison shopping across multiple retailers and combine shopping trips with dining and entertainment activities.
summary: A large regional mall in Cerritos serving Southeast LA County with over 130 stores and convenient freeway access.
